s: the boot-stomping, table-dancing après-ski institution of the Arlberg
w: Halfway down the slope into the village, MooserWirt turns into one of Europe's most famous après-ski parties the moment the lifts close -- skiers still in boots dancing on tables and benches, live Schlager and pop covers, and a volume of Jägermeister that has built its cult reputation over decades. Get there before 3pm or don't expect a spot on the terrace.
_facts: Located at Unterer Mooserweg 2, 6580 St. Anton am Arlberg, Austria, on the ski slope above the village
One of the most famous après-ski venues in the Alps, known for live music and dancing in ski boots
Regularly cited in "best/rowdiest après-ski" rankings across Europe
Gets extremely crowded from mid-afternoon as lifts close
